shared_elements: stylized upright anthropomorphic body or body parts
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces can be read as upright, highly schematic anthropomorphic forms with simple arm/hand or belt-like linear indications on the front. The major difference is that A is dominated by a single profile quadruped on an otherwise sparse surface, while B is dominated by a frontal face/body with circular facial features and dense geometric/linear ornament, so the iconographic schemes do not closely match.
